name.en: GT2 open timing belt, 2 mm pitch, 6 mm wide
name.es: Banda síncrona abierta GT2, paso 2 mm, 6 mm de ancho
name.fr: Courroie crantée ouverte GT2, pas de 2 mm, 6 mm de large
name.pt: Correia sincronizada aberta GT2, passo 2 mm, 6 mm de largura

description.en: An open-ended GT2 timing belt (2 mm pitch, 6 mm wide), cut to length, whose two ends are clamped. The A and B belts of a 2.4-class CoreXY gantry. It mates a clamp by each end; its run over pulleys and idlers is an assembly's declared belt path.
description.es: Una banda síncrona GT2 de extremos abiertos (paso 2 mm, 6 mm de ancho), cortada a medida y sujeta por sus dos extremos. Las bandas A y B de un pórtico CoreXY tipo 2.4. Se une a una mordaza por cada extremo; su recorrido por poleas es la trayectoria de banda declarada en un ensamble.
description.fr: Une courroie crantée GT2 ouverte (pas de 2 mm, 6 mm de large), coupée à longueur, dont les deux bouts sont pincés. Les courroies A et B d'un portique CoreXY de type 2.4. Elle s'accouple à une pince par chaque bout ; son parcours sur poulies et galets est le chemin de courroie déclaré d'un assemblage.
description.pt: Uma correia sincronizada GT2 de pontas abertas (passo 2 mm, 6 mm de largura), cortada à medida, presa pelas duas pontas. As correias A e B de um pórtico CoreXY do tipo 2.4. Acopla a uma garra por cada ponta; o seu percurso por polias é o caminho de correia declarado de uma montagem.

governing.designation: GT2 (Gates PowerGrip GT2, 2MR / LL-2GT) open belt, 2 mm pitch, 6 mm wide

sources.title: Timing Belt Tooth Profiles and Pitches (reference table)
sources.supports: 2MR/PGGT2 (Gates PowerGrip GT2, 2 mm): pitch 2 mm (0.079 in), belt height 1.52 mm (0.060 in), tooth depth 0.76 mm (0.030 in)

sources.title: SDP/SI Technical Section, Timing Belts, Pulleys, Chains and Sprockets (D820)
sources.supports: p. T-15, Fig. 19g (2 mm pitch GT3): pitch 2 mm, tooth height 0.030 in (0.76), belt height 0.060 in (1.52); p. T-16, §8 and Table 4: the pitch line lies in the tension cords, the distance U from the pitch line to the belt tooth bottom is 0.010 in (0.254 mm) for 2 mm GT3, and pulley OD = pd − 2U; p. T-66, Table 33 (2 mm PowerGrip GT2 belts): a 20-groove pulley has a pitch diameter of 12.73 mm (0.501 in); p. T-35, §13.3: at least 6 teeth in mesh and 60° of wrap on a loaded pulley

sources.title: VORON Design sourcing guide, sheet 'VORON 2.4' (the published Google sheet behind vorondesign.com/sourcing_guide, gid 1297316004)
sources.supports: GT2 Open Belt LL-2GT-6 (6mm wide), quantity 2, length dependent on configuration; Gates belts required for every open belt

sources.title: Voron 2.4r2 build guide, version 2023-07-04 (VoronDesign/Voron-2 @ a192410, Manual/Assembly_Manual_2.4r2.pdf, GPL-3.0); cited by page and section only, nothing copied
sources.supports: p. 125 (A/B Belts, overview): CoreXY belt path with the two belts stacked, the crossing omitted, both cut to the same length; p. 131: GT2 belt 6 mm wide, ends clamped in the X carriage with the teeth facing away from the extrusion

frame_convention: A straight belt laid out flat. Origin at end A, on the pitch line, at mid-width. +x runs along the belt to end B at x = length_mm; +y across the width; +z from the tooth side toward the back. The teeth lie between z = −1.014 (tooth tips) and z = −0.254 (tooth bottom, the land); the back is at z = +0.506. Both end interfaces are framed on the pitch line at the cut ends.

height.note: B, belt height (back to tooth tip)

pitch_line_differential.note: U, pitch line to tooth bottom: 0.010 in, SDP/SI Table 4 (2 mm GT3, the same 2 mm section: SDP/SI Fig. 19g and the cited 2MR/PGGT2 row agree on T 0.76 and B 1.52). Cross-check: the catalog's GT2 20T pulley (Adafruit 1251) has a toothed diameter of 12.2 against pd 12.73, i.e. U ≈ 0.27

teeth_side_offset.note: derived: T + U, pitch line above a smooth surface the tooth tips run on

back_side_offset.note: derived: B − T − U, pitch line above a smooth surface the back runs on

parameters.note: A convention: the belt is cut to its path (sourcing sheet: length dependent on configuration). An assembly's belt path reports the length it needs.

interfaces.note: Male: the belt end goes into a clamp. Symmetry 1: the teeth must face the clamp's toothed side. x_axis points to the back (+z of the belt frame).
As end_a, at the other cut end.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P6-GANTRY lane, 2026-10-04); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: Pre-landing record for ASM-1 §9 (v1.3): pitch and width are the belt block's required fields; height (B), tooth_depth (T), pitch_line_differential (U), teeth_side_offset (T + U) and back_side_offset (B − T − U) are its optional ones. A smooth via's effective diameter is its running_diameter plus twice the offset of the side that runs on it.
